title: Limiting Absorption Principle for the Helmholtz Equation with Sign-Changing Coefficients in Multilayer Spheres
summary: This paper investigates a multilayered Helmholtz model in $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d \ge 2$) characterized by concentric layers of materials with alternating positive and negative refractive indices. To overcome the loss of coercivity induced by the sign-changing material parameters, we construct a bespoke $\mathbb T$-coercivity operator to restore the coercive structure of the problem. Furthermore, to address the inherent lack of compactness on unbounded domains, we integrate a complex-wavenumber Dirichlet-to-Neumann (DtN) operator into this framework.
